name: Xcode DerivedData
note: Build intermediates and indexes. Xcode rebuilds these on the next build.

name: Xcode Archives
note: Archived app builds used for distribution. Keep if you still ship these.

name: iOS Device Support
note: Symbol files from devices you've debugged on. Re-downloaded when you reconnect a device.

name: watchOS Device Support
note: watchOS debug symbols. Re-downloaded when needed.

name: Xcode Device Logs
note: Old device connection logs. Safe to clear.

name: Simulator Caches
note: Cached simulator runtimes. Regenerated automatically.

name: Simulator Devices
note: Installed simulators and their data. Remove stale ones with simctl rather than deleting by hand.

name: Swift Package Manager
note: Swift PM download cache. Rebuilds on next resolve.

name: Carthage checkouts cache
note: Carthage binary cache. Re-downloaded on next carthage update.

name: JetBrains IDE caches
note: IntelliJ, WebStorm, PyCharm caches. Rebuilt on next launch.

name: JetBrains logs
note: IDE log files. Safe to clear.

name: Android Emulator
note: Android virtual device images. You'll need to recreate AVDs if removed.

name: Flutter pub cache
note: Dart/Flutter package cache. Re-downloaded on next flutter pub get.

name: Unity cache
note: Unity package cache. Projects may re-download packages.

name: Godot editor cache
note: Godot editor data. May reset editor preferences.

name: VS Code extensions
note: VS Code extension downloads and settings. Removing forces re-download of extensions.

name: VS Code app support
note: VS Code workspace state and caches. Safe-ish but you may lose recent window layout.

name: VS Code Insiders
note: VS Code Insiders state and caches.

name: VS Code caches
note: VS Code download and extension caches.

name: Windsurf IDE
note: Windsurf editor state and AI cache data.

name: npm cache
note: npm's download cache. Re-populates on next install.

name: Yarn cache
note: Yarn's package cache. Rebuilds on next install.

name: pnpm store
note: Content-addressable store shared across projects. Deleting forces re-download for every project.

name: Bun cache
note: Bun package cache. Rebuilds on next install.

name: Deno cache
note: Deno module cache. Re-downloaded when needed.

name: Homebrew downloads
note: Downloaded bottles/formulae. Safe to clear; `brew cleanup` does the same.

name: pip cache
note: pip wheel/download cache. Rebuilds on next install.

name: uv cache
note: uv (Python) package cache. Rebuilds automatically.

name: Conda packages
note: Conda package cache. May also exist at ~/anaconda3/pkgs.

name: Poetry cache
note: Poetry virtualenv and wheel cache.

name: pipenv cache
note: pipenv virtual environments. Recreate with pipenv install.

name: Cargo registry cache
note: Downloaded crate archives. Re-downloaded when needed.

name: Go build cache
note: Go compiler build cache. Rebuilds on next build.

name: Go module cache
note: Downloaded Go modules shared across projects. Re-downloaded on next build.

name: Gradle caches
note: Gradle dependency and build cache. Rebuilds on next build.

name: Maven repository
note: Local Maven artifacts shared across projects. Re-downloaded when needed.

name: SBT cache
note: Scala SBT boot and ivy cache.

name: Bazel cache
note: Bazel build output cache. Rebuilt on next build.

name: CocoaPods cache
note: CocoaPods download cache. Rebuilds on next `pod install`.

name: Composer cache
note: PHP Composer package cache.

name: Ruby gems cache
note: Ruby gem download cache.

name: nvm versions
note: Node versions installed via nvm. Reinstall with nvm install.

name: pyenv versions
note: Python versions installed via pyenv.

name: mise tool cache
note: mise/asdf runtime versions and shims.

name: Terraform plugins
note: Terraform provider plugin cache.

name: AWS CLI cache
note: AWS CLI autocomplete and cache data.

name: Prisma engines
note: Prisma query engine binaries. Re-downloaded on next generate.

name: Puppeteer browsers
note: Chromium downloaded by Puppeteer. Re-downloads when a script runs again.

name: Playwright browsers
note: Browsers downloaded by Playwright. Restored with `npx playwright install`.

name: Selenium drivers
note: Cached browser drivers. Re-downloaded when needed.

name: Electron downloads
note: Shared Electron cache used by many apps. Clearing may slow several apps on next launch.

name: Docker Desktop data
note: Docker's VM disk (images, containers, volumes). Never delete this folder by hand — reclaim space with prune, or reset via Docker Desktop → Troubleshoot.

name: Minikube cluster
note: Local Kubernetes cluster VM and state. Remove it with minikube, not by deleting the folder.

name: Colima VM
note: Colima container VM and disk. Remove it with colima to avoid orphaned state.

name: Rancher Desktop
note: Rancher Desktop VM and Kubernetes state.

name: Hugging Face models
note: Downloaded model weights and datasets. Large; re-downloaded on next use.

name: Ollama models
note: Local LLM weights (often tens of GB). Remove specific models with `ollama rm <model>`.

name: Claude Desktop data
note: Claude Desktop conversation cache and app data.

name: ChatGPT Desktop
note: ChatGPT macOS app cache and state.

name: Antigravity IDE data
note: Antigravity IDE working data. Large; only remove if you no longer use that IDE.

name: Antigravity backups
note: Backup snapshots from Antigravity IDE. Safe to clear if you don't need old snapshots.

name: LM Studio models
note: LM Studio model cache. Re-downloaded on next use.

name: Zoom
note: Temporary files stored by Zoom. Safe to delete — Zoom recreates them automatically.

name: Zoom logs
note: Zoom log files. Safe to clear.

name: Discord
note: Temporary files stored by Discord. Safe to delete — Discord rebuilds them when you next open it.

name: Discord GPU cache
note: Discord GPU cache under Application Support. Usually regenerable, but review — clearing can briefly affect performance until rebuilt.

name: Discord code cache
note: Discord Code Cache under Application Support. Usually safe, but not a one-click green clean — confirm you are not removing profile data.

name: Slack
note: Slack cache data. Rebuilt when Slack next launches.

name: Microsoft Teams
note: Teams cache. Safe to delete — Teams re-downloads as needed.

name: Microsoft Teams (new)
note: New Teams app cache. Safe to clear.

name: Spotify
note: May include offline downloads. Clearing can force re-download and change Spotify offline behavior.

name: Perplexity
note: Temporary files used by the Perplexity app. Regenerated when it checks for updates.

name: Perplexity updater
note: Perplexity desktop updater cache. Safe to clear.

name: Notion
note: Notion app cache. Syncs again from the cloud on next open.

name: Figma
note: Figma desktop cache. Rebuilt when you open files.

name: Telegram
note: Telegram media cache. Re-downloads media when viewed.

name: WhatsApp
note: WhatsApp cache. Media re-downloads from chats.

name: Steam
note: Steam shader/download cache. Games may re-verify; not always free to clear.

name: Epic Games
note: Epic launcher cache. Safe to clear.

name: Arc
note: Arc browser cache. Pages reload on next visit.

name: 1Password
note: 1Password cache. Vaults stay in the cloud, but clearing may sign you out or slow unlock — review first.

name: Dropbox
note: Dropbox sync cache. Clearing can trigger large re-downloads and temporary sync issues.

name: Google Drive
note: Google Drive cache. Clearing can force re-sync and affect offline files.

name: Location Analytics
note: Apple location analytics cache. System may rebuild; prefer review over bulk delete.

name: Apple Media Analysis
note: Photos/Spotlight media analysis cache. Rebuilds in background; can temporarily affect search.

name: App caches
note: Shared cache folder for many apps. Mostly safe, but review before clearing everything.

name: App logs
note: Entire ~/Library/Logs tree. Mostly logs, but review before wiping everything.

name: Chrome cache
note: HTTP cache only — not profiles, passwords, or extensions. Those live in Application Support/Google (Check first).

name: Firefox cache
note: Firefox browser cache.

name: Brave cache
note: Brave browser cache.

name: Google app data
note: WARNING: Chrome/Drive profile data under Library/Application Support. Cleaning may sign you out, remove extensions, or delete offline files / profiles.

name: Mail attachments cache
note: Mail.app downloaded attachments and cache. May re-download from server.

name: iOS device backups
note: iPhone/iPad backups. Only remove backups you no longer need.

name: Trash
note: Use the Trash section to empty. Do not treat ~/.Trash as a normal cache.
